lines.zh: 我一走，地上的石子就浮起来。
lines.en: As I walk, pebbles lift off the ground.
My golden hair does not bend in the wind.

lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚跟离地半寸。
lines.en: I glide, heels half an inch off the ground.

lines.zh: 这具身体比刚才轻多了。
lines.en: This body feels far lighter than before.
I am no longer holding back.
Each step leaks ki.
Dust parts into a path for me.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看远处，眼睛是青绿的。
lines.en: I look ahead; my eyes are teal.

lines.zh: 这个状态维持不了多久。
lines.en: This form will not last long.
I clench my fist; the joints pop.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，地陷了一小块。
lines.en: The ground dents under my step.

lines.zh: 我在压着气，别让它炸开。
lines.en: I hold my ki down so it does not burst.
The upright hair is heavier than it looks.
This power came too easily.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还能撑多久。
lines.en: I count how long I can hold this.
Everything sounds slower now.
My breath bends the grass.
I do not want to get used to this.
My nails grew. I will have to cut them.

lines.zh: 我站着，气在皮肤上噼啪响。
lines.en: I stand, ki crackling on my skin.

lines.zh: 这点能量就够毁掉一片林子。
lines.en: This much power could level a forest.
I close my eyes, then open them.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢这个状态的自己。
lines.en: I dislike the person in this state.
Ki burns hot in my palm.

lines.zh: 你现在的表情，很有意思。
lines.en: That face you are making is interesting.
Afraid? Good.
My ki trembles when I speak.

lines.zh: 我刚才不是这个语气吧。
lines.en: I did not sound like this a moment ago.
If you want to fight, hurry.
I am struggling to control my strength.
Move. Do not stand in my aura.
You cannot even endure my aura?
I laugh, and it does not sound like me.

lines.zh: 你知道我为什么变成这样吗？
lines.en: Do you know why I changed?
This gold — does it suit me?
I do not want to hear reason.
Come closer and I stop being polite.
My hands are burning.
That is not a threat. It is a warning.
I am speaking faster.
Do not let me see your fear.
I haven't used half my strength.
It hurts, but I am tough now.
That only made me angrier.

lines.zh: 血落在金色的气里，哧一声。
lines.en: Blood hisses in the gold aura.
My ki flares instead of fading.
Do not think you can interrupt me.
I grit my teeth; my eyes brighten.

lines.zh: 这点伤撑不到我变回来。
lines.en: This will not outlast my form.
I press my ribs and stand tall.
Again—my hair hasn't dimmed yet.
I am not hungry now.
Do not fob me off with that.
One bite, then we continue.

lines.zh: 力量比食物更让我上瘾。
lines.en: Power is more addictive than food.
Your hand shakes. Steady.
It has no taste to me.
I swallowed it. Satisfied?
My appetite is poor in this state.
Set it down. Do not come near.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我就当是挑衅。
lines.en: Bumping me reads as a challenge.
You cannot even shift my shoulder.
I did not move. You did.
You call that a collision?
Once more and I stop holding back.
Do not touch me. You will burn.

lines.zh: 我不想在这种状态下道歉。
lines.en: I do not want to apologize in this state.

lines.zh: 抱歉，气没收住，撞到你了。
lines.en: Sorry — my ki slipped and I bumped into you.

lines.zh: 现在不是想这个的时候。
lines.en: Not the time for that.
I am holding down my temper.
Ask me when I change back.
My voice is shaking.
I have no mind for it.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇头，头发纹丝不动。
lines.en: I shake my head; the hair does not stir.
I am afraid of hurting you.
Not now.
I turn away, ki still rising.
I cannot even control myself.
I raise a hand; it floats up.
I will not bend. Too much trouble.

lines.zh: 这东西被我的气烤热了。
lines.en: My aura heats it.
I hold it gently, afraid to crush it.
I must be careful with these hands.
Stow it. Do not drop it.
I left a dent in the ground.
This metal feels warm.
It feels weightless in my pocket.
Even this requires restraint.
I am going in.
This form cannot be dragged out.

lines.zh: 我的气把地面压出裂纹。
lines.en: My aura cracks the ground.
If you block, block to the end.
One punch ends it.
My hair brightens another shade.
Come on — my ki is gathered.
Be ready.
I am much faster than before.
Do not make me regret this.
Retreat now and it is not too late.
You cannot follow my speed.
Ki bursts under my feet.
By the time your hand lifts, I am there.
The Masenko is fully charged.
The instant you breathe in is enough.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛能看你身上的气。
lines.en: I can see the ki inside you.

lines.zh: 你退得越远，我追得越快。
lines.en: The farther you go, the faster I follow.
The gold is burning.
I come from the side — my ki arrives first.
Listen — even the wind lags.
I do not sway, I do not pant.
This one is called the Kamehameha.

lines.zh: 我把全身的气提到手上。
lines.en: I pull all my ki into my hands.
Your guard is full of holes.
Do not track me with your eyes.
I count to two.

lines.zh: 这一下会掀翻半个山坡。
lines.en: This will tear the hillside open.
Stand.
The air cracks under my fist.
My kick snaps your weapon.
I lost count of the combo.
I drive you into the dirt.
I catch your retreat.

lines.zh: 掌心的气推出去，一路犁开地面。
lines.en: Ki from my palm plows the ground open.

lines.zh: 我的速度快过你的反应。
lines.en: I outpace your reaction.

lines.zh: 这一拳擦到你的护甲，凹了。
lines.en: My fist grazes your plate and dents it.
Three more follow.
I hurl you into a trunk.
I pull back; my ki still crackles.
They call this the Meteor Combo.
Do not raise your head. Too slow.
I slam you back down.
This punch ends it.
I land with a boom.
I have changed.
My ki surges; the trees bend.
Look at this gold.
I left a crater where I landed.
I did not want this shape.
But I need it.
The wind is shoved aside by my aura.
Those behind you should step back.
My hair stands straight up.
Give me three minutes.
This power is hot.
I can hear things far away now.
Everyone, ten paces back.

lines.zh: 我控制不住力道，先说清楚。
lines.en: I cannot control my strength. Understand that.
Go ahead. I am waiting.

lines.zh: 火焰被我的气挡回去一半。
lines.en: My aura throws half the fire back.
I punch into the earth and climb out.

lines.zh: 水被我身上的热气蒸开。
lines.en: The heat around me boils the water.

lines.zh: 气浪撞上我的气，还是疼。
lines.en: The blast meets my aura and still hurts.
The shot melts as it reaches me.
Magic pierces me like a needle.
This form burns me dry.

lines.zh: 雷电缠着我的气，一起炸开。
lines.en: Lightning braids with my ki and bursts.
Even ki will not hold here.
